content:
{'text': 'In the UK, the communications regulator mandates that the World Cup be listed as a "Listed Sporting Event," meaning in principle all World Cup matches must be broadcast free-to-air over the airwaves, and the two broadcasters BBC and ITV cannot air advertisements during the drinks breaks. China\'s National Radio and Television Administration stipulates that broadcasting rights for the World Cup, Asian Games, and Olympics must be monopolised by CCTV, which at the last minute acquired the rights for this edition from FIFA at a lower-than-recent price.', 'translate': '在英國，通訊管理局規定將世界盃列入「指定體育賽事」(Listed Sporting Event)，理論上所有世界盃賽事需要經大氣電波免費轉播，同時兩間電視台 BBC 及 ITV 在補水暫停期間不播廣告。中國國家廣播電視總局規定世界盃、亞運及奧運轉播須由央視壟斷，後者在最後一刻以近年低價向 FIFA 購入今屆轉播權。'}

{'text': "PCCW wins broadcasting rights for third consecutive edition; per capita cost ranks among world's highest", 'translate': '電盈連續三屆奪轉播權 人均費用高踞世界前列'}

{'text': 'Back in Hong Kong, PCCW, which holds licences for both free and pay TV as well as fixed-line and mobile telecommunications, has secured the broadcasting rights for the third consecutive World Cup. In contrast, after TVB suffered losses following its World Cup broadcast and Cable TV wound down its pay-TV operations, there are no bidders in the market with the advantages of cross-platform and bundled sales.', 'translate': '回到香港，同時擁有免費及收費電視、以至固網和流動通訊牌照的電訊盈科，連續三屆取得轉播權。相反，在無綫經歷轉播世盃後虧蝕及有線結束收費電視後，市場上沒有具備跨平台和捆綁式銷售優勢的競投者。'}

{'text': 'FIFA is also believed to have sized up the "churn pressure" PCCW faces in customer retention, and has charged Hong Kong a certain broadcast fee. The exclusive Hong Kong broadcasting rights for this World Cup are reported to have been concluded for HK$170 million, slightly lower than in previous editions, but on a per capita basis Hong Kong still ranks among the world\'s highest. Although the "pass" fee for watching World Cup matches has not increased this edition, and with restaurants and eateries joining in the broadcasts, as well as the "online football talk buzz" giving fans more choices, the distance from returning to an era of "universal sharing" of the World Cup remains far off.', 'translate': 'FIFA 估計亦看準電盈在客戶留存方面面對的「cut 台」壓力，對香港收取一定的轉播費用。今屆世界盃賽事的香港獨家轉播權據報以 1.7 億港元成交，金額較以往略低，惟以人均成本計算，香港仍然高踞世界前列。雖然收看世界盃賽事的「通行證」費用今屆未有增加，而酒樓等食肆加入轉播外，「網上講波熱」亦令球迷多了選擇，但距離重返「全民共享」世界盃的年代仍然遙遙無期。'}

{'text': 'Commercial sponsors shape the rules of the game; it\'s far more than just "watching the match and casually checking out the boots"', 'translate': '商業贊助塑造比賽規則 點止「睇波順便睇下波鞋」'}

{'text': "During the World Cup, everything from pitch-side advertising to Video Assistant Referees (VAR) represents a golden opportunity to capture viewers' attention, making it easy to understand why commercial sponsorship and licensing is another important revenue source for FIFA. FIFA divides sponsors primarily into four tiers, and sponsors from around the world also compete covertly every four years over their global influence.", 'translate': '在世界盃舉行期間，從場邊廣告到視像裁判 (VAR) 都是爭取觀眾眼球的黃金機會，不難理解為何商業贊助及授權是 FIFA 另一重要收入來源。FIFA 將贊助商主要分成四個等級，世界各地贊助商每四年亦暗中較勁其全球影響力。'}

{'text': "FIFA's top-tier partners that have remained stable in recent editions are all globally renowned brands, including Adidas, Coca-Cola, Hyundai, and Visa. Partners also include potential host countries, for example Qatar Airways has been a sponsor since 2017, and Saudi Aramco, the national oil company of Saudi Arabia, which will host the 2034 World Cup, has also come on board as a sponsor from this edition onwards, in an open transaction with FIFA.", 'translate': '近幾屆穩定留下的 FIFA 頂級合作夥伴皆是全球知名品牌，包括 Adidas、可口可樂、現代汽車及 Visa。合作夥伴也包括潛在主辦國，例如卡塔爾航空自 2017 年開始贊助，2034 年世界盃主辦國沙特阿拉伯的國家石油公司沙特阿美 (Aramco)，由今屆起亦有份贊助賽事，與 FIFA 明買明賣。'}

{'text': 'Chinese sponsors, which have gained attention in recent editions with their Chinese-language advertising slogans, have slashed their sponsorship amounts for this edition by nearly 70%. Wanda, which was a top-tier partner for the past two editions, was removed for unpaid sponsorship fees, exiting alongside the mobile phone brand Vivo which departed at the same time. The remaining major Chinese sponsors include Lenovo and Hisense, which have title-sponsored the newly introduced "Referee Cam" and VAR display equipment respectively, as well as Mengniu, which frequently appears with the baffling slogan "If you can\'t drink milk, try soft milk."', 'translate': '近年以中文廣告標語搶鏡的中國贊助商，在今屆的贊助額大減近七成。過去兩屆屬於頂級合作夥伴的萬達，因為拖欠贊助費被除名，與同期的手機品牌 Vivo 一同退場。餘下的主要中資贊助商，尚有分別冠名贊助新加入「球證視角」鏡頭與 VAR 顯示設備的聯想和海信，以及經常以「不能喝牛奶，試試軟牛奶」口號出現，讓人感到一頭霧水的蒙牛。'}

{'text': "Haaland endorses Wong Lo Kat; Messi's Mengniu advertisement appears", 'translate': '夏蘭特代言王老吉 美斯蒙牛廣告現身'}

{'text': 'Time difference for kick-off and China-US relations may have affected Chinese sponsors\' willingness, but Chinese companies may also have realised that endorsements could be more effective than mere brand exposure. A case in point is the Wong Lo Kat herbal tea advertisement featuring Norwegian striker Haaland that was hotly debated online. French star Kylian Mbappé endorses "Boo Water," an electrolyte drink under Dongpeng Beverage, which was listed in Hong Kong with much fanfare this year, with the advertisement deliberately chosen to air during the drinks breaks. Spanish forward Lamine Yamal and Argentine maestro Messi also appear in this edition\'s Mengniu advertisement with the latter. When world-class footballers\' endorsement advertisements incorporate "Chinese characteristics," it is often perceived as an odd fit, but for Chinese companies, this contrast represents a traffic code.', 'translate': '開賽時差和中美關係可能影響中資贊助意欲，不過中國企業也許意識到，代言可能比品牌曝光成效顯著。網民熱烈討論挪威射手夏蘭特的王老吉涼茶廣告是例子。法國球星麥巴比則為今年在港高調上市的東鵬飲料旗下電解質飲品「補水啦」代言，廣告刻意挑選在補水時間播出。西班牙前鋒耶馬和阿根廷球王美斯亦與後者現身今屆賽事的蒙牛廣告。世界級球星代言廣告加入「中國特色」時常被認為存在違和感，但對中國企業而言，這種反差卻代表流量密碼。'}

{'text': "Shifts among World Cup sponsors are also reshaping the tournament's form. Although US domestic brands such as Bank of America, telecommunications company Verizon, and Frito-Lay (parent company of Lay's) have joined in succession, local host-country corporate sponsorships often prove short-lived. As for Japanese electronics companies, once regulars among World Cup sponsors, their disappearance from the pitch has been speculated as a signal of Japan's economic recession; in reality, many of them have shifted toward the commercial market, where profit margins are higher than those of consumer electronics, lacking the incentive to pursue global exposure.", 'translate': '世界盃贊助商的變動，也正在重塑盃賽的形態。雖然美國本土品牌例如美國銀行、電訊公司威訊 (Verizon)、以及樂事薯片母公司 Frito-Lay 等相繼加入，但主辦當地企業贊助往往曇花一現。至於以往曾經是世界盃贊助常客的日本電子企業淡出球場，被猜測是日本經濟衰退訊號，事實是當中不少轉向比消費電子產品利潤更高的商用市場，缺少誘因爭取全球曝光。'}

{'text': 'All non-sponsoring brands banned inside venues', 'translate': '場內禁止所有非贊助商品牌'}

{'text': 'The spectacle of Chinese sponsors rallying pitch-side in force during recent World Cup editions may in the future not be replaced by another emerging country, but rather gradually displaced by ambush marketing lying in wait outside the venues. Citing the protection of sponsor interests, FIFA strictly enforces "Clean Stadium" measures, banning all non-sponsoring brands from inside the venues. For example, Levi\'s Stadium, which is co-hosting this edition, has been temporarily renamed the San Francisco Bay Area Stadium, with white cloth used to cover the giant in-stadium signage of this jeans brand, while black tape is used to cover the logos of all condiments inside the venue. Yet brands such as Levi\'s and Heinz have turned the prohibition into a promotional opportunity. FIFA and its sponsors\' tight defence has been bypassed one by one by other brands, forcing a change in tactics.', 'translate': "過去數屆世界盃，中國贊助商群起在場邊打氣的情景，未來卻可能不是由另一新興國家取代，而是逐漸被在場外埋伏的精準行銷 (Ambush Marketing) 所取代。FIFA 以保護贊助商利益為由，嚴格執行「乾淨球場」(Clean Stadium) 措施，場內禁止所有非贊助商品牌。例如把今屆有份主辦的 Levi's Stadium 臨時改名為三藩市灣區球場，以白布覆蓋這個牛仔褲品牌的場內巨型標誌，同時用黑色膠紙蓋過場內所有調味料的商標。但品牌如 Levi's 和亨氏將計就計，把禁制令轉化成宣傳機會。FIFA 與贊助商的嚴密後防被其他品牌逐一扭過，不得不變陣。"}
